'''''Marguerite's Theorem''''' ({{langx|fr|Le Théorème de Marguerite}}) is 2023 French-Swiss drama film co-written and directed by {{ill|Anna Novion|fr}}. It is about a female mathematics student at [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|ENS]] whose career is upended when an error is discovered in her work.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2023/film/reviews/marguerites-theorem-review-le-theoreme-de-marguerite-1235642722/|title='Marguerite's Theorem' Review: A Bizarrely By-the-Numbers Fiction About the Gift/Curse of Math Genius|date=15 June 2023 |website=Variety}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.screendaily.com/news/pyramide-adds-le-theoreme-de-marguerite-with-ella-rumpf-legal-drama-sur-la-branche-to-efm-slate-exclusive/5179054.article|title=Pyramide adds 'Le Théorème de Marguerite' with Ella Rumpf, legal drama 'Sur La Branche' to EFM slate (exclusive)|website=Screen Daily}}</ref> It premiered on 22 May 2023 at the [[2023 Cannes Film Festival|76th Cannes Film Festival]]. It was distributed in France on 1 November 2023.

==Synopsis==
Marguerite is a young and brilliant mathematician, the only girl in her class at the [[École normale supérieure|ENS]], entirely devoted to her passion. The day an error is discovered in her thesis, she is devastated. In a dizzy spell, she leaves the school, wiping out the past. She then dives into the real world, discovers autonomy, befriends the young Noa, and has sex for the first time. Matured by her experiences, it is in this new momentum that she manages to find a correct proof of her theorem.

==Production==
To show mathematics realistically on the screen, Anna Novion worked with French mathematician [[Ariane Mézard]], who provided all the equations written by the characters in the film, so that they are all authentic. Moreover, Mézard even made real progress on [[Goldbach's conjecture]], the goal of Marguerite's work, for the film.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.allocine.fr/article/fichearticle_gen_carticle=1000048946.html|title=Le Théorème de Marguerite : présenté à Cannes, ce film a permis à la science de progresser ! | first = Isaac | last= Barbat| website=AlloCiné |date= 2 Nov 2023| access-date=24 June 2024}}</ref>

==Release==
''Marguerite's Theorem'' was selected to be screened in the Special Screenings section at the [[2023 Cannes Film Festival|76th Cannes Film Festival]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://cineuropa.org/en/newsdetail/441512/|title=13 new titles added to Cannes' Official Selection|last=Lemercier|first=Fabien|date=25 April 2023|website=[[Cineuropa]]|access-date=6 February 2024}}</ref> where it had its world premiere on 22 May 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |last=mraultpauillac |date=10 May 2023 |title=The Screenings Guide of the 76th Festival de Cannes |url=https://www.festival-cannes.com/en/2023/the-screenings-guide-of-the-76th-festival-de-cannes/ |access-date=6 February 2024 |website=Festival de Cannes}}</ref>

The film was theatrically released in France by Pyramide on 1 November 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Le théorème de Marguerite |url=http://distrib.pyramidefilms.com/pyramide-distribution-prochainement/le-theoreme-de-marguerite.html |access-date=6 February 2024 |website=distrib.pyramidefilms.com}}</ref><ref name="NUM">{{Cite The Numbers |id=theoreme-de-Marguerite-Le-(2023-France) |title=Le théorème de Marguerite (2023) |access-date=21 September 2024}}</ref>

==Reception==
=== Box office ===
''Marguerite's Theorem'' grossed $0 in North America<ref name="NUM"/> and $1.2 million in other countries,<ref name="BOM"/> against a production budget of about $3.2-3.4 million.<ref name="budget"/><ref name="budget2"/>
